description: Commission of Elections - The Media Guidelines made by the Elections Commission under Article 104B(5)(a) of  the Contitution of  the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka
reasoning: This gazette contains media guidelines issued by the Election Commission under constitutional authority, establishing regulatory frameworks and compliance requirements for media institutions during election periods. It focuses on legal/regulatory matters rather than government personnel changes, structural changes, or other specialized categories. The content consists of binding rules and procedures that media must follow, making it a Legal/Regulatory Gazette.
